notes:
v1.0.43 - FPS control refinements (VSync off, launch confirmation, jar cleanup).

1) NEW setting 'Force VSync off': a 60 Hz panel with VSync on caps the
game at 60 FPS no matter the frame cap. When enabled, the launcher writes
enableVsync:false into options.txt on every launch (only that one line,
works with both the capped and unlimited paths).

2) Launch confirmation logs: every launch now logs the ACTUAL FPS state
the game starts with (options.txt maxFps + enableVsync, unlimitedFps flag,
tier) and the FPS Boost jar(s) present in mods/ - so any future FPS
report is debuggable from real logs.

3) Stale jar cleanup: ensureFpsBoost now sweeps the profile's mods dir
and removes any leftover Reimagined FPS Boost jars (.jar and .jar.disabled)
from older launcher versions, even when the profile is already current.
